用于持续强化学习的操作员引导不变性学习Operator-Guided Invariance Learning for Continuous Reinforcement Learning

Zuyuan Zhang
The George Washington University
zuyuan.zhang@gwu.edu
&Fei Xu Yu
The George Washington University
fxyu@gwu.edu
&Tian Lan
The George Washington University
tlan@gwu.edu
摘要Abstract

具有连续时间和状态/动作空间的强化学习（RL）通常是数据密集型的，并且在令人讨厌的变化和变化下很脆弱，从而激发了利用保值结构来稳定和改进学习的方法。大多数现有方法侧重于特殊情况，例如规定的对称性和精确的等方差，而没有解决如何发现更一般的结构，这些结构需要非线性算子在具有同构值函数的连续状态/动作系统之间进行转换和映射。我们建议Reinforcement learning (RL) with continuous time and state/action spaces is often data-intensive and brittle under nuisance variability and shift, motivating methods that exploit value-preserving structures to stabilize and improve learning. Most existing approaches focus on special cases, such as prescribed symmetries and exact equivariance, without addressing how to discover more general structures that require nonlinear operators to transform and map between continuous state/action systems with isomorphic value functions. We proposeVPSD-RL（强化学习的保值结构发现）。它将连续强化学习建模为受控扩散，并具有通过李群操作和相关回拉算子定义的保值映射。我们证明，当拉回价值函数并推动行动与受控生成器和奖励函数交换时，恰好存在价值保留结构。此外，当 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman 失配较小时，可以找到具有严格保证的近似保值结构。该框架通过搜索相关的李群算子来发现精确和近似的保值结构。 VPSD-RL 适合可微分漂移、扩散和奖励模型；通过确定方程残差最小化来学习无穷小生成器；用 ODE 流对它们求幂以获得有限变换；并通过过渡增强和变换一致性正则化将它们集成到连续强化学习中。我们表明，有界生成器/奖励失配意味着最优价值函数沿近似轨道的定量稳定性，其灵敏度由有效范围控制，并观察到连续控制基准上数据效率和鲁棒性的提高。(Value-Preserving Structure Discovery for Reinforcement Learning). It models continuous RL as a controlled diffusion with value-preserving mappings defined through Lie-group actions and associated pullback operators. We show that a value-preserving structure exists exactly when pulling back the value function and pushing forward actions commute with the controlled generator and reward functional. Further, approximate value-preserving structures with rigorous guarantees can be found when the Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman mismatch is small. This framework discovers exact and approximate value-preserving structures by searching for the associated Lie group operators. VPSD-RL fits differentiable drift, diffusion, and reward models; learns infinitesimal generators via determining-equation residual minimization; exponentiates them with ODE flows to obtain finite transformations; and integrates them into continuous RL through transition augmentation and transformation-consistency regularization. We show that bounded generator/reward mismatch implies quantitative stability of the optimal value function along approximate orbits, with sensitivity governed by the effective horizon, and observe improved data efficiency and robustness on continuous-control benchmarks.

1 简介Introduction

强化学习 (RL) 在各种顺序决策任务中取得了巨大成功，但众所周知，现代 RL 在复杂环境中样本效率低下，并且在令人讨厌的变化和变化下变得脆弱Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved great success across a variety of sequential decision-making tasks, yet modern RL are known to be sample-inefficient in complex environments and brittle under nuisance variability and shifts(Puterman, 2014; Sutton et al., 1998; Bertsekas, 2012; Kaelbling et al., 1996; Mnih et al., 2015; Schulman et al., 2015, 2017; Haarnoja et al., 2018; Xiang et al., 2019; Fujimoto et al., 2018; Kober et al., 2013; Levine et al., 2020; Zhang et al., 2026c, b, a, 2025)。 一个关键的挑战不仅仅是优化或探索，还包括. A key challenge is not optimization or exploration alone but also底层结构的有限开发limited exploitation of underlying structures：如果存在保留（或接近保留）最优价值函数的转换，则价值学习可以在其他不同的转换/轨迹上进行泛化，从而显着提高一致性，降低复杂性并稳定学习: if transformations exist to preserve (or nearly preserve) the optimal value function, value-learning can generalize across otherwise distinct transitions/trajectories, significantly improving consistency, reducing complexity, and stabilizing learning(Dean and Givan, 1997; Ravindran and Barto, 2001, 2004; Li et al., 2006)。这种观点包含了先前的实践，例如已知形式的不变性诱导结构（如对称性、旋转和线性缩放），并提出了一个更雄心勃勃的目标：. This viewpoint subsumes prior practice such as known forms of invariance-inducing structures (like symmetry, rotation, and linear scaling) and suggests a more ambitious goal: to发现discover从数据中精确地和近似地分析一般保值结构和相关的转换，并在强化学习中利用它们，同时确保对政策绩效的严格保证general value-preserving structures and associated transformations–both exactly and approximately–from data and exploit them in reinforcement learning, while ensuring rigorous guarantees on the policy performance(Tobin et al., 2017; Laskin et al., 2020b; Yarats et al., 2021; Cohen and Welling, 2016; Bronstein et al., 2021).

这在时间和状态连续强化学习中尤其具有挑战性，这种强化学习通常被建模为受控扩散，这是一种广泛使用的数学原理模型 在机器人技术、金融和物理过程中This is particularly challenging in time- and state-continuous reinforcement learning, which is often modeled as controlled diffusion, a mathematically principled model widely used in robotics, finance, and physical processes(Oksendal, 2013; Karatzas and Shreve, 2014; Fleming and Soner, 2006; Yong and Zhou, 1999; Borkar and Borkar, 2008; Kushner, 1990)。在该模型中，最优性由. In this model, optimality is governed by an操作员operator—受控生成元（或诱导半群）—以及粘性形式的贴现 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) 方程—the controlled generator (or the induced semigroup)—and by the discounted Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman (HJB) equation in viscosity form(Crandall et al., 1992; Bardi et al., 1997; Barles, 1994)。我们通过李群动作（由于考虑的连续空间）和相关的回拉算子来定义保值变换/映射。因此，我们表明，转型是否“保值”必须通过操作员层面的问题来解决：是否拉回价值函数（并推动行动）. We define value-preserving transformations/mappings by Lie-group actions (due to the continuous spaces under consideration) and associated pullback operators. Consequently, we show that whether a transformation is “value-preserving” must be addressed through an operator-level question: Whether pulling back the value function (and pushing forward actions)通勤commutes与受控发电机和奖励功能，精确或近似。with the controlled generator and the reward functional, exactly or approximately.

这种以操作员为中心的视图提供了一种新颖且易于处理的方法来发现通用的保值结构This operator-centric view provides a novel and tractable method to discover general value-preserving structures(Fleming and Soner, 2006; Bardi et al., 1997)时间和空间连续强化学习。现有方法仅考虑某些已知形式和特殊情况，例如等变 RL 的精确对称性in time- and space continuous RL. Existing approaches only considered certain known forms and special cases, such as exact symmetry by equivariant RL(Cohen and Welling, 2016; Kondor and Trivedi, 2018; Weiler and Cesa, 2019; Maron et al., 2018; Hutchinson et al., 2021; Bronstein et al., 2021)和通过表示学习获得不变特征and invariant features by representation learning(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2019; Laskin et al., 2020a; Stooke et al., 2021)。数据增强方法. Data augmentation methods(Tobin et al., 2017; Laskin et al., 2020b; Yarats et al., 2021)如果关系已知，可以提高学习的稳健性。经典的同构和同态形式化了 MDP 中的等价关系，但 仅关注离散时间和离散状态问题can improve learning robustness if the relations are already known. Classical isomorphism and homomorphism formalize equivalence relations in MDPs, yet focusing only on discrete-time and discrete-state problems(Dean and Givan, 1997; Ravindran and Barto, 2001, 2004; Li et al., 2006).

我们提出的方法，Our proposed approach,VPSD-RL（强化学习的保值结构发现），通过相对于受控生成器和奖励函数的精确或近似交换属性定义候选变换，使用 打折的HJB运营商(Value-Preserving Structure Discovery for Reinforcement Learning), defines candidate transformations through an exact or approximate commutation property with respect to the controlled generator and reward function, using the discounted HJB operator(Fleming and Soner, 2006; Crandall et al., 1992; Bardi et al., 1997)。从算法上来说，VPSD-RL：(1) 学习. Algorithmically, VPSD-RL: (1) learns无穷小infinitesimal通过最小化确定方程残差来生成生成器； (2) 通过 ODE 流对学习到的向量场求幂以获得有限变换； (3) 通过转换增强和价值/策略网络的转换一致性正则化器将这些转换注入强化学习中generators by minimizing determining-equation residuals; (2) exponentiates the learned vector fields via ODE flows to obtain finite transformations; and (3) injects these transformations into RL through transition augmentation and a transformation-consistency regularizer for value/policy networks(Olver, 1993; Bluman et al., 1989; Ibragimov, 2024; Lee, 2003)。一个值得注意的副产品是，当发现的结构整合到（局部）群作用时，它会恢复经典李对称性. A notable byproduct is that, when the discovered structure integrates to a (local) group action, it recovers classical Lie symmetries as a特殊情况special case而不是设计前提rather than a design premise(Olver, 1993; Bluman et al., 1989).

从理论上讲，我们证明精确的保值结构意味着最优值的精确值不变性，而近似的生成器/奖励不匹配产生了稳定性界限Theoretically, we prove that exact value-preserving structure implies exact value invariance of the optimal value, while approximate generator/reward mismatch yields the stability bound‖V⋆∘gϑ−V⋆‖∞≤1β​(εr+εℒ​‖V⋆‖C2).\|V^{\star}\circ g_{\vartheta}-V^{\star}\|_{\infty}\leq\frac{1}{\beta}\Big(\varepsilon_{r}+\varepsilon_{\mathcal{L}}\|V^{\star}\|_{C^{2}}\Big).我们进一步为 VPSD-RL 管道建立端到端的保证：随机结构发现以标准 SGD 速率收敛到近似平稳点，学习到的无穷小生成器在可实现性下在统计上是一致的，数值流积分具有有序性We further establish end-to-end guarantees for the VPSD-RL pipeline: stochastic structure discovery converges to approximate stationary points at standard SGD rates, learned infinitesimal generators are statistically consistent under realizability, numerical flow integration has order-hph^{p}误差和精确/近似过渡增强分别保留贝尔曼不动点或以受控量扰动它。 VPSD-RL 在代表性连续控制基准上展示了更高的数据效率和稳健性error, and exact/approximate transition augmentation respectively preserves the Bellman fixed point or perturbs it by a controlled amount. VPSD-RL demonstrates improved data efficiency and robustness on representative continuous-control benchmarks(Fujimoto et al., 2018; Haarnoja et al., 2018).

8 结论Conclusion

我们介绍了We introducedVPSD-RL，一个操作员级框架，用于发现和利用连续时间强化学习中的保值结构。 VPSD-RL 没有假设规定的对称性，而是通过变换后的受控生成器的换向和 HJB 算子的奖励来定义精确和近似的保值，使经典的李对称性成为一种特殊情况。 我们表明，精确的保值结构意味着值不变性，而有界生成器/奖励不匹配会产生沿着近似轨道的最优值的定量稳定性。 然后，我们将这些原理转化为实用的管道，从数据中学习无穷小生成器，将它们求幂为有限变换，并将它们用于转换增强和变换一致性正则化。 由此产生的理论和实验表明，保值结构发现可以提高连续控制强化学习中的数据效率和鲁棒性，特别是当有用的变换存在但事先未知时。这些增益应该在规定的局部建模假设下进行解释：学习的流是局部的，并且它们的可靠性通过残差和不变性诊断进行评估。附录中讨论了局限性和更广泛的影响。, an operator-level framework for discovering and exploiting value-preserving structure in continuous-time reinforcement learning. Rather than assuming a prescribed symmetry, VPSD-RL defines exact and approximate value preservation through commutation of the transformed controlled generator and reward with the HJB operator, making classical Lie symmetries a special case. We showed that exact value-preserving structure implies value invariance, while bounded generator/reward mismatch yields quantitative stability of the optimal value along approximate orbits. We then turned these principles into a practical pipeline that learns infinitesimal generators from data, exponentiates them into finite transformations, and uses them for transition augmentation and transformation-consistency regularization. The resulting theory and experiments suggest that value-preserving structure discovery can improve data efficiency and robustness in continuous-control RL, especially when useful transformations are present but not known in advance. These gains should be interpreted under the stated local-modeling assumptions: the learned flows are local and their reliability is assessed through residual and invariance diagnostics. Limitations and broader impacts are discussed in Appendix.

附录BAppendix B理论保证Theory Guarantees

我们提供三层保证，反映了部分中的管道We provide three layers of guarantees that mirror the pipeline in Section5。 首先，我们为平滑度和有界方差下的随机结构发现提供标准的非凸优化保证。 其次，在可实现性和一致的动态估计下，我们陈述了一致性结果，表明学习的领域 收敛（在数据测量中）到确定方程的解，这意味着数据支持上的算子不匹配消失。 第三，我们限制了有限步 ODE 求解器在对学习向量场求幂时引入的数值误差。 最后，为了给出一个不受演员训练非凸性影响的端到端非渐近声明， 我们包括一个离散时间表格模拟，显示精确/近似保值增强如何扰乱贝尔曼固定点。. First, we give standard nonconvex optimization guarantees for stochastic structure discovery under smoothness and bounded variance. Second, under realizability and consistent dynamics estimation, we state a consistency result showing that the learned fields converge (in data measure) to a solution of the determining equations, implying vanishing operator mismatch on the data support. Third, we bound numerical errors introduced by finite-step ODE solvers when exponentiating the learned vector fields. Finally, to give an end-to-end non-asymptotic statement free of actor-training nonconvexity, we include a discrete-time tabular analogue showing how exact/approximate value-preserving augmentation perturbs the Bellman fixed point.

B.4 离散时间模拟：保值增强贝尔曼备份A Discrete-Time Analogue: Value-Preserving Augmented Bellman Backups

上述连续时间理论解释了为什么（近似）生成器等方差会导致（近似）值不变性。 为了提供完全非渐近的端到端收敛声明，避免非凸演员训练， 我们还提出了一个离散时间表格模拟，其中值迭代是收缩和定点扰动 可以明确地界定。The continuous-time theory above explains why (approximate) generator equivariance leads to (approximate) value invariance. For the planar-orbiting case, definegθ⋅s:=(Rz​(θ)​x,Rz​(θ)​xd,ξ),hθ⋅a:=Rz​(θ)​a.g_{\theta}\cdot s:=\bigl(R_{z}(\theta)x,\;R_{z}(\theta)x_{d},\;\xi\bigr),\qquad h_{\theta}\cdot a:=R_{z}(\theta)a.如果受控动力学和奖励仅取决于相对几何形状和变换不变控制量， 那么生成器级保值条件和奖励兼容性成立：If the controlled dynamics and reward depend only on relative geometry and transformation-invariant control quantities, then the generator-level value-preserving condition and reward compatibility hold:La​Ugθ=Ugθ​Lhθ​(a),r​(gθ⋅s,hθ⋅a)=r​(s,a).L_{a}U_{g_{\theta}}=U_{g_{\theta}}L_{h_{\theta}(a)},\qquad r(g_{\theta}\!\cdot s,\;h_{\theta}\!\cdot a)=r(s,a).因此，最优策略可以沿着轨道一致地传输，Hence the optimal policy can be transported consistently along the orbit,π⋆​(gθ⋅s)≈hθ⋅π⋆​(s).\pi^{\star}(g_{\theta}\!\cdot s)\approx h_{\theta}\!\cdot\pi^{\star}(s).

同样的视角超越了全球对称坐标。 对于执行 8 字形机动的无人机，可以在轨迹的两个波瓣上对齐重复的相位匹配相对配置。 这些匹配的配置不需要形成全局坐标对称，但当局部控制语义、几何和奖励保持接近时，它们仍然可以引起近似保值对应关系。 这说明了为什么我们的方法的目标是更广泛的保值结构，而不仅仅是对称性。The same perspective extends beyond globally symmetric coordinates. For a UAV executing a figure-eight maneuver, one can align repeated phase-matched relative configurations across the two lobes of the trajectory. These matched configurations need not form a global coordinate symmetry, but they can still induce approximate value-preserving correspondences when the local control semantics, geometry, and reward-to-go remain close. This illustrates why the target of our method is broader value-preserving structure rather than symmetry alone.

D.3 实现细节：模型拟合和流程集成Implementation details: model fitting and flow integration

数据收集用于发现。Data collection for discovery.

发现对转换元组进行操作Discovery operates on transition tuples(s,a,r,s′)(s,a,r,s^{\prime})在 RL 训练期间在线收集。 对于同策略方法，我们使用最近推出的方法；对于离策略方法，我们从重播缓冲区中采样。 为了稳定确定残差优化，我们 (i) 在当前状态分布中平衡小批量， (ii) 使用运行统计数据标准化状态分量（位置/速度尺度）。collected online during RL training. For on-policy methods, we use recent rollouts; for off-policy methods, we sample from the replay buffer. To stabilize the determining-residual optimization, we (i) balance minibatches across the current state distribution, and (ii) normalize state components (position/velocity scales) using running statistics.

动力学和奖励建模。Dynamics and reward modeling.

对于合成环境，真实漂移/扩散/奖励通过分析可知 等式。 （For synthetic environments, ground-truth drift/diffusion/reward are known analytically via Eqs. (36)–(47), (41)–(42), 并用于计算真实值生成器和诊断对齐。 对于复杂环境（SymNav 和 MuJoCo），发现模块适合本地代理模型 用于漂移), and are used to compute ground-truth generators and diagnostic alignment. For complex environments (SymNav and MuJoCo), the discovery module fits local surrogate models for driftb​(s,a)b(s,a)和奖励and rewardr​(s,a)r(s,a)通过一步转换回归：by regression on one-step transitions:

b^​(s,a)≈s′−sΔ​t,r^​(s,a)≈r.\widehat{b}(s,a)\approx\frac{s^{\prime}-s}{\Delta t},\qquad\widehat{r}(s,a)\approx r.

如果使用扩散模型，我们参数化If a diffusion model is used, we parameterizeQ​(s,a)Q(s,a)通过 PSD 形式（例如对角线或 Cholesky 因子） 以确保半正定性。配置文件中提供了所有精确的架构选择和优化器设置。through a PSD form (e.g., diagonal or Cholesky factor) to ensure positive semidefiniteness. All exact architectural choices and optimizer settings are provided in the config files.

（或其方法部分中的耦合版本），使用固定步长显式求解器（默认为 RK4）。 我们在对称范围内积分(or its coupled version in the method section), using a fixed-step explicit solver (RK4 by default). We integrate over a symmetric rangeα∈[−αmax,αmax]\alpha\in[-\alpha_{\max},\alpha_{\max}]与步长with step sizehh。 对于受限环境（PostConstraint-Rot2D），我们应用与环境相同的投影/回缩策略： 位置被投影到可行环面，并且当投影发生时径向速度分量被移除 （等式。（. For constrained environments (PostConstraint-Rot2D), we apply the same projection/retraction policy as the environment: position is projected to the feasible annulus and the radial velocity component is removed when projection occurs (Eqs. (45)–(46））。 我们拒绝导致数值不稳定（NaNs/Infs）的转换，并在这种情况下回退到身份增强。)). We reject transformations that cause numerical instability (NaNs/Infs) and fall back to identity augmentation in that case.

附录EAppendix E局限性和更广泛的影响。Limitations and broader impact.

VPSD-RL 依赖于可微的代理漂移、扩散和奖励估计，以及局部有效的李群流。当学习生成器识别不佳、动态强烈不连续或保值关系仅在狭窄的数据支持上成立时，其性能可能会下降。当前的评估仅限于受控模拟基准，因此在安全关键型机器人或物理系统中的部署需要额外的验证、约束检查和分布转移下的监控。预期的积极影响是提高连续控制强化学习的数据效率和稳健性；一个可能的负面影响是，当近似不变性假设失败时，过度信任高风险自治系统中习得的转换。VPSD-RL relies on differentiable surrogate drift, diffusion, and reward estimates, as well as locally valid Lie-group flows. Its performance may degrade when the learned generator is poorly identified, when the dynamics are strongly discontinuous, or when the value-preserving relation holds only on a narrow data support. The current evaluation is limited to controlled simulation benchmarks, so deployment in safety-critical robotic or physical systems requires additional validation, constraint checking, and monitoring under distribution shift. The expected positive impact is improved data efficiency and robustness in continuous-control RL; a possible negative impact is over-trusting learned transformations in high-stakes autonomous systems when the approximate-invariance assumptions fail.
